ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web, there is a box labeled "mallee fowls" located at the lower middle; in the upper right there is a box labeled "eagles". In the figure, there is an arrow from "mallee fowls" pointing to "eagles", indicating that eagles feed on mallee fowls or obtain energy from them. Reasoning: The question asks what would happen to the number of eagles if all the fowls died. Because fowls are one of the food sources of eagles, after losing this food source, the food obtained by eagles decreases, so the population number of eagles would decline.
